mapper.sql: check_id AS checkId, case_id AS caseId, case_subject_id AS caseSubjectId, program_check_id AS programCheckId, check_mode AS checkMode, provider_code AS providerCode, request_ref AS requestRef, status, outcome, reason_code AS reasonCode, evidence_ref AS evidenceRef, note, reviewer_id AS reviewerId, reviewed_time AS reviewedTime, valid_until AS validUntil, reused_from_case_id AS reusedFromCaseId, operated_by AS operatedBy, on_behalf_of_partner_id AS onBehalfOfPartnerId, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dd_check(check_id, case_id, case_subject_id, program_check_id, check_mode, provider_code, request_ref, status, outcome, reason_code, evidence_ref, note, reviewer_id, reviewed_time, valid_until, reused_from_case_id, operated_by, on_behalf_of_partner_id, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.checkId}, #{row.caseId}, #{row.caseSubjectId}, #{row.programCheckId}, #{row.checkMode}, #{row.providerCode}, #{row.requestRef}, #{row.status}, #{row.outcome}, #{row.reasonCode}, #{row.evidenceRef}, #{row.note}, #{row.reviewerId}, #{row.reviewedTime}, #{row.validUntil}, #{row.reusedFromCaseId}, #{row.operatedBy}, #{row.onBehalfOfPartnerId}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_dd_check WHERE case_id IN #{id} ORDER BY case_id, check_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_dd_check SET status = 'COMPLETED', outcome = #{outcome}, reason_code = #{reasonCode}, evidence_ref = #{evidenceRef}, note = #{note}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_time = #{now}, valid_until = #{validUntil}, operated_by = #{operatedBy}, on_behalf_of_partner_id = #{onBehalfOfPartnerId}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE check_id = #{row.checkId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
